Faded headlights. Slight break in front right headlight base. Broken left mirror. Tears in 4 door weatherstrips. Missing right side door moldings. Broken rear right and left taillights. Broken rear bumper mount without cover. Front left fender signal light issue. Two front wheel well liners needed. Needs full exhaust system. Fading and dents on exterior body. Corrosion/rust in front left pillar. Torn dashboard/firewall insulation. Broken OBD diagnostic port. Needs professional car care detailing. Fully repainted except for roof, trunk, one door, and rear right fender.
